585)kun mkhyen bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi lung bstan la sgro btags te legs phyogs nas smos pa ni/khyab bdag ston pa kun bzang he ru kaḥgasang chen bstan pa'

tei:div.tei:p: 585) kun mkhyen bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi lung bstan la sgro btags te legs phyogs nas smos pa ni/ khyab bdag ston pa kun bzang he ru kaḥ gsang chen bstan pa'-i sdud po'i tshul bstan kyang*// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug che// gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// spyan ras gzigs dbang srong btsan sgam po'i dus// rgyal ba mchog dang jo bo yid bzhin nor// bod du drangs ba'i chos blon mgar dam pa// stong btsan yul bzung zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs khri srong lde'u btsan sku yi sras// o rgyan mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i thugs kyi sras// rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus gsung gi mdzod 'dzin pa// dam 'dzin mu rub btsad por= gsang bdag khri ral bod kyi mgon byon tshe// nyag phran rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon pos// bdud rje glang gi klad pa 'gem byed pa// lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjer= pu ri rin chen 'bar ba'i klong sgrom nas// bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma/ rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus zab gter sgo brgya 'byed// sprul sku sangs rgyas gling par gsol ba= kun mkhyen chen po 'jigs med gling pa yi// rtsa 586)ba'i chos bdag snying thig snying po'i don// rtogs sgom mthar phyin rdo yul grub chen pa/ kun bzang gzhan phan zhabs la= mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rjes rjes bzung bas// sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs sngags kyi spyod pa skyong*// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor snying po'i don gzigs pa// phun tshogs 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol= kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos rjes bzung bas/ mdo sngags rig gnas thos bsam phyogs med 'byongs// 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam la zhugs/ dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal la= byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe// dag pa'i zhing khams bde ldan bkod pa ru// stobs bcu'i dbang phyug nyid du byang chub pa'i// padma'i lung bstan thob la gsol ba 'debs// gsol 'debs bu la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// yang dag lta dang nges 'byung byang sems ldan/
bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i gsang lam nas// tshe 'dir mngon 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis rlobs/
/zhes pa'ang lha rigs pa karma'i ngor rang nyid kyis so//
